title: 第23章 热闹的九舍第24章 平头舍霸
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
我居然在这里遇到了胡列娜？
张三感觉自己的脑袋在嗡嗡作响，他明明记得胡列娜是一直养尊处优的天才，尤其是觉醒武魂后先天满魂力的她直接成了比比东的亲传弟子，武魂殿的圣女，被视作教皇的接班人。
也就是说，胡列娜在武魂殿的地位是真正的一人之下万人之上的存在。
以至于武魂殿立国后，在女皇比比东不在时，胡列娜直接可以统御三军，成为武魂帝国实际上的话事人。
不过张三仔细一想，突然觉得这个情况也不是不可能。
毕竟张三记得自己是比胡列娜长一岁的，现在自己六岁，那胡列娜就是五岁。
既然这胡列娜现在才五岁也就没有觉醒武魂，自然没人会认为她是个天才并给予资源培养。
而且张三记得，胡列娜的父母因一次事故都已亡故，具体是什么事故张三也不清楚，但这件事确实让胡列娜成了孤儿。
只是对方居然会来圣心孤儿院这是张三没想过的。
毕竟这个胡列娜再怎么说背后也是依附武魂殿的魅狐宗和邪刃宗，和自己这种毫无背景的草根是不一样的，这两大宗门势力不小，也曾出过武魂殿供奉这样可威震大陆的强者，本身也有封地和爵位，可是真正的权贵之家。
就算她父母双亡，可再怎么说她也应该有亲戚来照料才对，怎么就落魄到要来孤儿院了呢？
但假设真的因为各种原因，让胡列娜和她的哥哥邪月离开他们的家族势力，那么位于武魂城内且颇为有名的圣心孤儿院，确实是一个好选择。
当然张三还是想不明白，究竟是什么缘由才让这对生在象牙塔上的兄妹俩得入这凡尘。
但不管张三想不想得明白，这胡列娜和她哥哥邪月看起来都是要一起入住这圣心孤儿院了。
那些仆从已经在搬运马车上那大包小包的行李，而那金发贵妇人则在和克劳斯一边商谈着什么，一边迈着优雅的步子往圣心孤儿院大门口走去，那对兄妹也怯生生地紧随其后。
“快走开！看什么热闹？”
几个卫兵过来将堆在门口的人们都驱赶开了，以免堵塞道路。
“孩子们，快走、快走，这里没什么好看的。”
而且很快也有女护工来驱赶堆在圣心孤儿院大堂里的孩子们，让他们也快些走开。
张三对此感到有些不快。

这些贵人们和普通人当然是两个世界的人，可难得接触到贵族的平民孩子们只是站在这里，想要看看那些高贵的人儿是不是比他们多长了什么鼻子眼睛，就有人过来驱逐他们。
不过张三这边虽然心怀不满，但也不想挑事，于是他就跟着人潮一起退散了。
张三之所以对胡列娜的过往不是特别了解，就是因为胡列娜不是别人，作为武魂殿高层的胡列娜尽管不是直辖张三的领导但也算是张三的上级。
张三这边要调动武魂殿的情报网络查清圣女的身世过往，就和意图谋逆差不多，若是此事传到胡列娜或者教皇耳边，自己百分百要凉凉。
当然作为武魂殿圣女的胡列娜，其身世经历，武魂殿高层肯定是清清楚楚的，只是张三这边职权卑微没有这个资格去知道这些事情罢了。
但是一想到自己当年居然和幼年的胡列娜有住在同一屋檐下的机会，只是自己光顾着去那什么魂师学院进修错过了。
纵使是张三也得感叹一声造化弄人。
不过既然现在的胡列娜很可能只是一个大家族的弃子，正是落魄之时，那么……
我该怎么报复她呢？
没错，张三和胡列娜可是有不少纠葛的。
他在武魂殿一直过得不痛快，也和胡列娜有不少关系。明明张三不记得自己怎么招惹她了，她就是经常找张三的茬，什么端茶送水的活都让他干过，真就把他当仆人使唤。贡献到了也不给他升职，气得张三咬牙切齿又无可奈何。
她的兄长邪月也一样没给张三好脸色过，甚至安排过好几次相当危险的任务给他，好在张三命大都死里逃生了。
但张三和胡列娜的仇怨也并非是纯粹的私怨。
content_en:
I actually met Hu Liena here?
Zhang San felt that his head was buzzing. He clearly remembered that Hu Liena was a genius who had always been pampered and pampered. Especially after awakening her martial soul, she was born with full soul power and directly became Bibi Dong's personal disciple, the saint of the martial soul hall, and was regarded as the successor of the Pope.
In other words, Hu Liena's status in Wuhun Palace is that of one person and above ten thousand people.
So much so that after the establishment of the Wuhun Palace, Hu Liena could directly command the three armies in the absence of Queen Bibi Dong and became the de facto voice of the Wuhun Empire.
However, Zhang San thought about it carefully and suddenly felt that this situation was not impossible.
After all, Zhang San remembers that he is one year older than Hu Liena. Now that he is six years old, Hu Liena is five years old.
Since Hu Liena is only five years old and has not awakened her martial spirit, naturally no one will think that she is a genius and give her resources to train her.
Moreover, Zhang San remembered that Hu Liena's parents died in an accident. Zhang San didn't know the specific accident, but this incident did make Hu Liena an orphan.
It's just that Zhang San never thought that the other party would come to the Sacred Heart Orphanage.
After all, no matter what Hu Liena said, she was still attached to the Charming Fox Sect and the Evil Blade Sect of the Wuhun Palace. They were different from a grassroots like her who had no background. These two sects were quite powerful. They had also left the Wuhun Palace to worship such powerful men who could shake up the continent. They also had fiefs and titles, and they were truly the homes of the powerful.
Even if her parents are dead, she should have relatives to take care of her anyway. Why is she so depressed that she has to come to an orphanage?
But assuming that Hu Liena and her brother Xieyue really left their family power for various reasons, then the famous Sacred Heart Orphanage located in Wuhun City is indeed a good choice.
Of course, Zhang San still couldn't figure out why the two brothers and sisters who were born in the ivory tower entered this mortal world.
But whether Zhang San understood it or not, Hu Liena and her brother Xie Yue seemed to be moving into the Sacred Heart Orphanage together.
The servants were already carrying the large and small bags of luggage on the carriage, while the blond lady was discussing something with Klaus while walking elegantly towards the gate of the Sacred Heart Orphanage, followed timidly by the brother and sister.
"Go away! What fun are you watching?"
Several guards came over and drove away the people who were piled at the door so as not to block the road.
"Kids, come on, come on, there's nothing to see here."
And soon a female nurse came to drive away the children piled in the lobby of the Sacred Heart Orphanage, asking them to move away quickly.
Zhang San felt a little unhappy about this.
Of course, these nobles and ordinary people are from two different worlds, but the commoner children who rarely come into contact with the nobles just stand here, wanting to see if those noble people have more noses and eyes than them, and someone comes to drive them away.
However, although Zhang San was dissatisfied, he did not want to stir up trouble, so he retreated with the crowd.
The reason why Zhang San doesn't know much about Hu Liena's past is because Hu Liena is none other than Hu Liena. As a senior executive of Wuhun Palace, Hu Liena is Zhang San's superior even though she is not directly under Zhang San's leadership.
Zhang San's intention to mobilize Wuhun Palace's intelligence network to find out the saint's life experience is similar to his intention to rebel. If this matter reaches the ears of Hu Liena or the Pope, he will definitely be cooled.
Of course, as the Saint of Wuhun Palace, Hu Liena's life experience must be clear to the senior officials of Wuhun Palace, but Zhang San's position is low and he is not qualified to know these things.
But when I thought about the opportunity to live under the same roof as the young Hu Liena, I just missed it by attending some soul master academy.
Even Zhang San had to sigh that fate was playing tricks on people.
But since Hu Liena nowIt is very possible that he is just an abandoned son of a big family, and he is in a state of decline, so...
How can I get back at her?
Yes, Zhang San and Hu Liena had a lot of entanglements.
He had always been unhappy in Wuhun Hall, and he had a lot to do with Hu Liena. Obviously Zhang San didn't remember how he provoked her, but she always found trouble with Zhang San. She had let him do all the work of serving tea and water, and she really treated him like a servant. He was not promoted despite his contribution, which made Zhang San grit his teeth and helpless.
Her brother Xieyue also didn't give Zhang San a good look, and even arranged several quite dangerous tasks for him. Fortunately, Zhang San mostly escaped death.
But the hatred between Zhang San and Hu Liena is not purely personal.
